references.role: shared sea-blue palette and whale-girl context

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: tiny raster spot illustration for a blue whale-girl visual language asset library.
Style/medium: clean bold flat 2D kawaii illustration with thick, smooth deep sea-blue outlines and simple blue / white fills. Excellent silhouette readability when displayed at only 32 pixels. Flat color, with at most one tiny simple highlight; no texture, no gradients, no shading complexity.
Color palette: deep sea-blue outline #1a365d, blue #2b6cb0, bright blue #4299e1, soft white #f7fafc. No warm main colors.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered subject filling roughly 75% of a square canvas, complete unclipped silhouette, balanced proportions.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background with alpha; no scene, no ground shadow, no color backdrop.
Constraints: no text, numbers, label, watermark, border, sticker border, frame, decorative stars, hearts, sparkles, grid, collage, extra objects.
Primary request: one recognizable beamed eighth-note pair, two solid round note heads connected through two stems and one thick joining beam, a compact musical symbol. Blue fill with thick dark sea-blue outline. No other marks.
assets.note: Original image-generation output, copied byte-for-byte. No post-processing.
assets.visual_review: Inspected the displayed generated output: requested subject, coherent blue/white palette, bold readable outline, complete silhouette and no text.
